# DoSRAGBench — Refusal-rate monitor

*Generated by `scripts/refusal_monitor.py`. Clean refusal rate p0 calibrated on queries 0–499; everything else measured on held-out queries 500–999. A window of n queries alarms when its refusal count exceeds the one-sided binomial threshold at α = 0.01. Cells are the smallest window (of 10, 20, 30, 50, 75, 100, 150, 200, 300, 500) that detects the attack with ≥ 90% power when a fraction f of the window's queries is attacked; — = not detected even at n = 500. False alarm = empirical alarm rate on clean-only windows of 100. 2000 simulated windows per cell.*
